# zone_ssh_whitelist_ip (Resource)

An address allowed to reach a webhosting service's SSH.

These only take effect when `zone_ssh_settings` has `access = "whitelist"`; with `access = "public"` they are recorded and ignored.

~> **This resource cannot be changed in place.** Its endpoint offers no update operation, so every argument below forces Terraform to destroy and recreate it. That is cheap here — the object carries no data — but it does mean a brief window with the entry absent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A single address, or a network with a prefix length.
resource "zone_ssh_whitelist_ip" "office" {
  service_name = "virt1.example.com"
  ip           = "217.128.0.0/24"
  comment      = "Office"
}

resource "zone_ssh_whitelist_ip" "ci" {
  service_name = "virt1.example.com"
  ip           = "2001:db8::10"
  comment      = "CI runner"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The address to allow. A network may be given with a prefix length, for example `217.128.0.0/24`.
- `service_name` (String) The webhosting service this belongs to. This is a virtual server name, which often looks like a domain but is a different namespace from a DNS zone — use the `zone_vservers` data source to list the valid values. Changing it moves the resource to another service, which means replacing it.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A note on the entry, shown in the ZoneID panel.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier assigned by zone.eu.
- `resource_url` (String) API URL of this entry.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Either the numeric id or the address works. The address may carry a prefix
# length, and the import ID is split on its first slash only.
terraform import zone_ssh_whitelist_ip.office "virt1.example.com/217.128.0.0/24"
terraform import zone_ssh_whitelist_ip.office "virt1.example.com/81489"
```
